brief: Help our team explore how to rebuild customer trust. Support says unreliable releases matter most; Sales believes the bigger issue is confusing packaging; Product worries that a feature freeze would lose important customers. These are competing interpretations, not established facts. We have two months to learn, and are not choosing a final strategy today. Preserve the disagreement, expand our ideas and suggest a few small experiments.
